description: Execute a VIA toll operation through the existing One-Call payment and delivery handler. First call without payment returns the live x402 offer; only after buyer approval, retry IDENTICAL task, maxUsdc and private orderId with the buyer-signed payload in params._meta['x402/payment']. Buyer pays VIA before an eligible external supplier is paid; VIA relays delivery and retains its margin. Only supported tasks/suppliers. No automatic signing or financial retry. Prepaid comparison credits do not fund this tool.

maxUsdc.description: Maximum approved total in USDC, including supplier and VIA margin.

orderId.description: Private client-generated UUIDv4. Required for execution; preserve it and the exact body for payment retry and recovery.

name: via_one_call
